title: SCOTUS rejects an appeal by BMG, Sony Music, UMG, and Warner Music, upholding a decision that copyright termination rights apply globally, not just in the US (Blake Brittain/Reuters)
summary: Blake Brittain / Reuters: SCOTUS rejects an appeal by BMG, Sony Music, UMG, and Warner Music, upholding a decision that copyright termination rights apply globally, not just in the US — The US Supreme Court rejected on Monday a challenge by a group of music labels to a judicial decision that said a law allowing creators …
